why: #38644: palette handlers for Move Browser Profile to Position, Set and Remove Browser Profile Proxy (BrowserProfileHandlers, BrowserProfileService+Records) and Manage Billing (UpgradeToPro). They need BrowserProfileService, AppActionContext.browserProfile and AppControl.openBillingPage, which are App-only types, so no lower package can hold them; Allow Desktop Notifications binds in CmuxNextNotifications and the notification control methods moved there too, which pays for the rest.
